summary: Frontend-only testing of ARETION & Company landing page completed. All 14 acceptance criteria from the review request pass. data-testids present, hrefs/targets correct, content matches, sticky header works, 6 consultant cards render, smooth scroll works, mobile menu functional, zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero subheadline contains the exact required phrase but appends additional editorial copy (' — strategy, operations, policy and capital, delivered by a curated council of senior advisors.'). The required substring is still present, so the test passes, but main agent should confirm this trailing copy is intentional per design.
Nav link 'nav-contact' points to #footer, and 'nav-approach' points to the CTA section (#approach). These are reasonable mappings but worth confirming with product intent.
All anchors use rel='noopener noreferrer' with target=_blank — good security hygiene.
Footer privacy/terms links currently point to '#privacy' and '#terms' which scroll to top (no such sections). Acceptable for a static brief, but consider linking to real pages later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page is fully static (no backend integration). All required data-testids are present and verified: landing-page, site-header, brand-logo, nav-{consultants,approach,insights,contact}, header-cta-button, hero-section, hero-headline, hero-subheadline, hero-cta-primary, hero-image-wrapper, hero-credential, consultants-grid, consultant-card-0..5, consultant-name-/spec-, cta-section, cta-heading, main-cta-button, site-footer, footer-email, footer-phone, footer-address, social-{linkedin,twitter,instagram}, footer-link-privacy, footer-link-terms, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, mobile-cta-button. External CTA URL https://platform.aretion.com/join verified on header/hero/main CTA with target=_blank. Smooth scroll from nav-consultants to consultants-section verified (scrollY≈section top). Mobile menu opens at 375x800 with 5 nav links + CTA.
